title: Quantitative Magnetization Transfer MR Imaging of Diabetic Mouse Kidney
author: Feng Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8a7hshn

steps.title: Prepare Animal and MRI System
steps.instruction: Set up the imaging environment and maintain animal stability.

substeps.instruction: Use a 7T horizontal bore imaging system with a Doty 38-mm inner diameter transceiver coil.
Induce and maintain anesthesia using a 1.5%/98.5% isoflurane/oxygen mixture.
Maintain a constant body temperature of 37.5ºC using heated air flow.

steps.title: Acquire Structural and Segmentation Images
steps.instruction: Obtain anatomical images to guide kidney segmentation and slice placement.

substeps.instruction: Set the field-of-view (FOV) to 34x34 mm2.
Acquire water images for kidney segmentation using a 3-point Dixon reconstruction (gradient echo sequence, TR = 45 ms, flip angle = 35º, TEs approximately 4, 4.5, and 5 ms).
Use axial and sagittal anatomical images to place a single oblique coronal slice at the equatorial position of the left and right kidneys.

steps.title: Collect Quantitative Magnetization Transfer (qMT) Data
steps.instruction: Perform qMT imaging using a 2D MT-weighted spoiled gradient recalled-echo sequence.

substeps.instruction: Set sequence parameters: TR 24 ms, flip angle = 7º, matrix size 256x256, 24 acquisitions, and resolution ~0.133x0.133x1 mm3.
Apply Gaussian-shaped saturation pulses with pulse width = 10 ms at two saturation powers (θsat = 220º and 820º).
Acquire data at 7 RF offsets ranged between 1 and 80 kHz for each of the two saturation powers (total imaging time ~34 min).
Obtain observed relaxation rate R1obs using images acquired with two flip angles.
Generate B1 map using images acquired with two flip angles.
Generate B0 map using two gradient echo images with ΔTE = 2 ms.

steps.title: Process and Analyze MRI Data
steps.instruction: Analyze the acquired images using MATLAB 2014b to derive qMT parameters.

substeps.instruction: Coregister all intrasession images using a rigid registration algorithm based on mutual information.
Manually segment kidneys based on T1-weighted images.
Calculate T1obs using the dual-angle approach.
Apply Henkelman-Ramani’s model and the continuous wave power approximation (CWPE) to derive qMT parameters (M0, F, RM0b, T2a, and T2b).
Impose constraints during fitting: fix Rb at 1 s⁻¹ and link Ra to the independently measured R1obs.
Define the Proton Spin Density (PSR) as the 'F' value from the fitting.
Evaluate fitting quality at each pixel using the root mean squares (RMS) of the residuals at each RF offset.

steps.title: Quantify Regions of Interest (ROI)
steps.instruction: Perform regional quantification and statistical analysis of the kidney.

substeps.instruction: Manually select ROIs (cortex, outer medulla [OM], inner medulla and papilla [IM+P], and extra-renal space) using T1-weighted and MT contrast (MTC) images.
Identify fibrosis regions based on high PSR values.
Define the normal PSR range as Mean ± 2SD of normal WT mice.
Detect regions with PSR higher than thresholds of Mean+2SD, Mean+3SD, or Mean+4SD and calculate the percent area of these regions in the cortex.
Evaluate measurement differences using Student’s t-tests and calculate correlations with histological results using the Pearson correlation function.
